gaps.explanation: p5 (Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds). The fund columns are complete in detail[]: General 47,865 + Streets 30,677 + Cemetery 901 + Weston 150 8,172 + Keno capital outlay 612 = 88,227 = printed TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS 88,227 (p5, also p2 Total Governmental Activities 88,227 and p9 budget 88,227). The statement lines are taken from the Total Governmental Funds column, whose row cells do not add to its own total: General government 48,477 + Street 30,677 + Cemetery 901 + Weston 150 8,172 + Capital outlay 612 = 88,839. The Total-column 'General government' 48,477 is 612 more than the only fund cell in that row (General Fund 47,865); 48,477 - 47,865 = 612 = Keno Fund capital outlay, which the Total column also prints separately as Capital outlay 612, so the 612 is counted twice in the statement lines (already recorded in report_discrepancies). The statement line that is off is disbursements 'General Government' 48,477 (p5): the printed total and every fund column support 47,865. Schedule 88,227 is correct; no detail fix.

Statement business-type disbursements 183,965 = p7 Total Proprietary Funds TOTAL OPERATING DISBURSEMENTS 177,678 + Bond interest 6,287. detail[] has the p7 per-fund lines for business-type receipts but none of the p7 per-fund disbursement lines; business-type spending in detail comes only from the all-funds Budgetary Comparison Schedule (p9, detail indexes 0-4: Electric 24,474 + Sewer 67,972 + Water 33,433 + Water debt service 11,739 + Other 30,333 = 167,951), which is on the budget basis: it leaves out depreciation (Water 3,674 + Sewer 17,792 = 21,466) and includes water bond principal 5,452 (debt service 11,739 vs bond interest 6,287; p9 reconciliation 'Change in liabilities (5,452)', 'Change in Accumulated depreciation 21,466'); 21,466 - 5,452 = 16,014 = gap. Per the per-fund detail rule (cities and villages: one line per fund column of the proprietary statement; combined schedule lines removed), add the 19 printed non-zero p7 fund-column disbursement cells and remove the 5 combined budget-schedule lines (keeping both would count the same spending twice). Added: Electric 5,278 + 13,185 + 4,078 + 1,933 = 24,474; Water 5,836 + 5,626 + 4,953 + 17,018 + 3,674 = 37,107 plus Bond interest 6,287; Sewer 5,836 + 3,709 + 51,311 + 7,116 + 17,792 = 85,764; Garbage 29,147 + 1,186 = 30,333; sum 183,965. Check: 167,951 + 183,965 - 167,951 = 183,965 = statement 183,965.
